run_egl_rendering_loop: run a pybullet simulation loop that renders camera images using the EGL hardware OpenGL renderer plugin
load_egl_plugin: load the eglRendererPlugin for hardware-accelerated OpenGL rendering in pybullet direct mode
load_urdf_models: load URDF models like plane.urdf and r2d2.urdf into the pybullet simulation environment
compute_view_matrix: compute a camera view matrix from yaw, pitch, and roll angles using computeViewMatrixFromYawPitchRoll
get_camera_image: get a rendered camera image with RGB and depth data using getCameraImage with hardware OpenGL
